description: Cross-platform permission registry and runtime helpers for Expo, React Native, and React Native Web apps, with unified request/check APIs for camera, media, location, notifications, microphone, and other web/native capabilities.

readmeUsage.title: Basic permissions runtime example.
readmeUsage.description:
Basic permissions runtime example.

Create a permission client, provide it at the app root, and use
`usePermission` to read, refresh, and request a normalized permission state.

readmeUsage.title: Expo permissions runtime example.
readmeUsage.description:
Expo permissions runtime example.

Create the Expo permission client from the optional Expo entrypoint, provide
it at the app root, and call `request()` only from an explicit user action.

exports.name: assertKnownPermission
exports.description: Throws for programmer errors where an invalid permission reaches runtime.

exports.name: createFakePermissionClient
exports.description:
Creates a deterministic in-memory client for tests and examples.

Fake clients make permission flows testable without native devices, browser
prompts, simulators, or network access.

exports.name: createPermissionClient
exports.description:
Creates a permission client backed by Expo SDK modules.

Denials that Expo cannot request again are normalized to `blocked`. Limited
media-library access and provisional or ephemeral iOS notification access
are normalized to usable `limited` states, where `granted` remains true.
The client requires `expo-linking` for settings recovery and rejects with a
stable error when the operating-system settings page cannot be opened.

Expo modules are loaded only when a client operation uses them. The package
root and Expo manifest metadata remain free of native module imports.

exports.name: createPermissionManager
exports.description:
Creates a permission manager from a runtime-specific client.

The manager validates permission names and normalizes client results.
Native app configuration remains a separate build-time concern.

exports.name: createPermissionState
exports.description:
Creates a normalized state and derives the `granted` convenience flag.
Limited access is usable partial authorization, so both `granted` and
`limited` states set `granted` to true.

exports.name: createWebPermissionClient
exports.description:
Creates a browser permission client using guarded structural globals.

Unsupported web APIs resolve to `status: 'unavailable'`. The adapter does not
import DOM types and does not assume it is running in a browser.

exports.name: EXPO_PERMISSION_CLIENT_REQUIRED_PACKAGES
exports.description:
Expo packages required by the permission client independently of a specific
permission capability.

exports.name: FakePermissionClient
exports.description: Test client that stores permission states in memory.

exports.name: Permission
exports.description:
Common runtime permissions supported by the registry.

The registry is intentionally platform-neutral. Adapters translate each
permission into whatever a browser, React Native app, Expo app, or test
environment can actually check or request.

exports.name: PERMISSION_REGISTRY
exports.description: Metadata for known permissions.

exports.name: PERMISSION_STATUSES
exports.description: Stable ordered list of normalized statuses.

exports.name: PermissionClient
exports.description:
Adapter-neutral contract for checking and requesting permissions.

Implementations provide permission state and permission requests for a runtime environment.

exports.name: PermissionDefinition
exports.description: Describes a known permission without coupling the registry to a platform SDK.

exports.name: PermissionEnvironment
exports.description: Broad environment categories where a permission can be meaningful.

exports.name: PermissionHookResult
exports.description: Result returned by `usePermission`.

exports.name: PermissionManager
exports.description: Public facade for checking and requesting normalized permission state.

exports.name: PERMISSIONS
exports.description: Stable ordered list of known permissions.

exports.name: permissionsPackageMetadata
exports.description: Public package metadata used by generated documentation and tooling.

exports.name: PermissionsProvider
exports.description:
Provides a permission manager to React hooks.

React helpers are framework-neutral. They depend on React only and do not
import browser, Expo, or React Native permission APIs.

exports.name: PermissionsProviderProps
exports.description: Props accepted by `PermissionsProvider`.

exports.name: PermissionState
exports.description: Normalized result returned by permission clients and managers.

exports.name: PermissionStatus
exports.description:
Normalized permission statuses shared by adapters and UI code.

Denial is normal control flow. Unexpected adapter failures may still throw,
but user denial should be represented as a permission state.

exports.name: usePermission
exports.description: Tracks a single permission and exposes explicit refresh/request actions.

exports.name: UsePermissionOptions
exports.description: Options for `usePermission`.

exports.name: usePermissions
exports.description: Reads the current permission manager from context.

exports.name: WebPermissionClientOptions
exports.description: Options for the browser permission adapter.
